observation: Third, previously-undocumented divergence between GgenIgniter.Query.run/2 (sparql hex) and GgenIgniter.Query.Oxigraph.run/2: sparql-hex has no error-handling branch. (1) ASK queries silently return SELECT-shaped WHERE-clause bindings instead of a boolean (real wrong-answer bug, not a crash). (2) CONSTRUCT raises a raw unwrapped MatchError. (3) Malformed queries raise a raw unwrapped MatchError instead of a clear error. (4) Bare FILTER NOT EXISTS (no UNION/BIND) still raises Protocol.UndefinedError -- broader than the already-documented UNION+BIND-specific crash in query.ex's own moduledoc.
evidence: test/ggen_igniter_ask_construct_engine_divergence_test.exs (6 real, passing tests, no mocks) and test/ggen_igniter_sparql_engine_test.exs (9 real tests); real repro via mix run against RDF.Graph.new/1 graphs, e.g. Query.run(graph, "ASK { ?s ?p ?o }") returns [%{"s"=>..,"p"=>..,"o"=>..}] rows, and Query.run(graph, "CONSTRUCT {...} WHERE {...}") raises %MatchError{term: %RDF.Graph{...}}
blocked_on: lib/ggen_igniter/query.ex is outside agent5's write-scope (lib/ggen_igniter/query/*, lib/ggen_igniter/engine* only -- query.ex is a sibling file, not under query/). Recommend: (a) add an {:ok,_}/{:error,_} guard (or explicit ASK/CONSTRUCT query-form detection) to GgenIgniter.Query.run/2 mirroring GgenIgniter.Query.Oxigraph.run/2's error handling, and (b) update query.ex's own moduledoc to document this third divergence and the broader (UNION/BIND-independent) FILTER NOT EXISTS crash.
